results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Prof. Fabio Giglietto is featured as the lead researcher on a University of Urbino study examining over 2.5 million Meta posts. The study documents how Meta's political content reduction policy reduced the Facebook visibility of elected Italian parliamentarians by 72% while unexpectedly increasing exposure for extremist accounts. Giglietto provides expert commentary on the democratic risks of platform recommendation algorithms and how transparency provisions in the EU Digital Services Act enabled the research.
